content.text: Sxtomatic hypophosphatemia, incl severe cases w osteomalacia and fractures, has occurred; monitor serum phosphate in pts @ risk for chronic ↓phosphate. Watch for hypersensitivity during and for ± 30 minutes after each infusion, and for HTN after each dose.
